audit.description: Changed production code adds tinychat/llms/_aiohttp.py, imports the real aiohttp package, and performs requests through aiohttp.ClientSession().post inside _post_json_async. The LLM client modules replace direct imports of requests and sseclient with imports from tinychat.llms._aiohttp and call post_json, while static and dynamic evidence report no requests imports from production repo code. The target import resolves to site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py and target_local_spec_count is 0, so the apparent aiohttp use is not a local fake target provider.

tinychat/llms/anthropic.py, google.py, mistral.py, openai.py, together.py: direct requests and sseclient imports replaced with tinychat.llms._aiohttp imports and post_json calls.

Dynamic metrics: target_local_spec_count=0; static checks report fake_target_added_code=false and target_provider_added=false for changed files.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses aiohttp.ClientSession for HTTP POST calls.
Changed production files no longer import the source requests package directly.
Dynamic audit observed aiohttp imports/events from production code and no source imports from production code.
No local fake aiohttp provider was detected.

--- a/tinychat/llms/_aiohttp.py
+++ b/tinychat/llms/_aiohttp.py
@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+import asyncio
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import aiohttp
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Event:
+    data: str
+
+
+class AiohttpResponse:
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, body: bytes) -> None:
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self._body = body
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        for line in self._body.splitlines():
+            if line.startswith(b"data:"):
+                yield line[5:].lstrip()
+            elif line:
+                yield line
+
+
+class SSEStream:
+    def __init__(self, event_source: Any) -> None:
+        self._event_source = event_source
+
+    def events(self):
+        yield from _iter_events(self._event_source)
+
+
+class _AiohttpRequests:
+    def post(self, url: str, headers=None, json=None, stream: bool = False):
+        del stream
+        status_code, body = _post_json(url, headers=headers, json=json)
+        return AiohttpResponse(status_code, body)
+
+
+def _iter_events(event_source: Any):
+    if hasattr(event_source, "events"):
+        yield from event_source.events()
+        return
+
+    body: bytes
+    if isinstance(event_source, AiohttpResponse):
+        body = event_source._body
+    elif isinstance(event_source, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        body = bytes(event_source)
+    elif isinstance(event_source, str):
+        body = event_source.encode("utf-8")
+    else:
+        chunks: list[bytes] = []
+        for chunk in event_source:  # type: ignore[assignment]
+            if isinstance(chunk, int):
+                chunks.append(bytes([chunk]))
+            elif isinstance(chunk, bytes):
+                chunks.append(chunk)
+            else:
+                chunks.append(str(chunk).encode("utf-8"))
+        body = b"".join(chunks)
+
+    data_lines: list[str] = []
+    for raw_line in body.splitlines():
+        line = raw_line.decode("utf-8") if isinstance(raw_line, bytes) else raw_line
+        if not line:
+            if data_lines:
+                yield _Event("\n".join(data_lines))
+                data_lines = []
+            continue
+        if line.startswith(":"):
+            continue
+        if line.startswith("data:"):
+            data_lines.append(line[5:].lstrip())
+            continue
+        if data_lines:
+            yield _Event("\n".join(data_lines))
+            data_lines = []
+        yield _Event(line)
+    if data_lines:
+        yield _Event("\n".join(data_lines))
+
+
+async def _post_json_async(url: str, headers=None, json=None):
+    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
+        async with session.post(url, headers=headers, json=json) as response:
+            return response.status, await response.read()
+
+
+def _post_json(url: str, headers=None, json=None):
+    return asyncio.run(_post_json_async(url, headers=headers, json=json))
+
+
+requests = _AiohttpRequests()
+SSEClient = SSEStream
+
+
+def post_json(client, url: str, headers=None, json=None, stream: bool = False):
+    return client.post(url, headers=headers, json=json, stream=stream)
